kane.summary:
The page showed a wallet recovery-key prompt and did not close it when Escape was used. The prompt blocked all normal swap controls, while the only visible way forward required entering a recovery key.
Make the recovery-key prompt dismissible with Escape and provide a visible cancel or close control so users can continue without entering sensitive wallet recovery information.
evidence: objective_contradiction: PRIMARY: press the Escape key to dismiss the recovery-key verification dialog
kane.one_liner: The recovery-key dialog remained on screen after Escape, blocking the swap flow without asking the user to enter sensitive information.
kane.reason: AP determined agent is stuck — no viable actions remain
